sanskrit: idaṃ te śiro bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te mastiṣkaṃ ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: This head of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — this brain of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: idaṃ te hanū bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te jihvāṃ ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: These jaws of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — this tongue of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: idaṃ te grīvā bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te skandhān ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: This neck of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — these shoulders of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: idaṃ te aṃsau bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te bāhū ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: These two shoulder-joints of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — these arms of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: idaṃ te hṛdayaṃ bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te klomānaṃ ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: This heart of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — this right lung of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: idaṃ te pṛṣṭīr bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te parśūr ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: These ribs of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — these rib-bones of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: idaṃ te śroṇī bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te vastraṃ ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: These hips of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — this entrail of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: idaṃ ta ūrū bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te jaṅghe ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: These two thighs of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — these two shanks of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: idaṃ te kulphau bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te pādau ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: These two ankles of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — these two feet of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: idaṃ te tvacaṃ bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te prāṇān ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: This skin of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — these life-breaths of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: idaṃ te parūṃṣi bhinadmi yātudhāna svāhā- -idaṃ te majjño ni tṛṇadmi bhūmyām ||
english: These joints of yours I split, O sorcerer — svāhā! — this marrow of yours I crush into the earth.

sanskrit: nardamodalavuntaka jiṣṇo hāparājitaḥ | amuṃ bhrūṇāny arpaya svayaṃ pāśaṃ ny āyati ||
english: O Nardamoda, O Lavuntaka, O Jiṣṇu, O Aparājita — drive the embryonic forces against that one; the snare comes upon him of its own accord.

sanskrit: asur aitu sahakratur ātmā prāṇo atho balam | sa no dadhātu bhadrayā- -agnir viśvād vasumān svastaye ||
english: Let the vital breath come together with will-power, let the self, the breath of life, and bodily strength come forth; may Agni, rich in all treasures, bestow upon us that [vitality] with good fortune for our well-being.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇā mā dakṣiṇato dakṣiṇā pātu savyataḥ | paścād anuvyādhāt pātu purastāt pātu dakṣiṇā ||
english: May Dakṣiṇā protect me from the right side; may Dakṣiṇā protect me from the left. May she protect me from the wound-dealing [danger] behind; from in front may Dakṣiṇā protect me.

sanskrit: śatam āpo divyā mitrasya ca dakṣiṇāḥ | dhātā savitād rudras te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: A hundred are the divine waters and the beneficent gifts of Mitra; may Dhātṛ, Savitṛ, and Rudra release us from distress.

sanskrit: śataṃ pāśā varuṇasya brahmaṇaspater u śatam | martāt pāśān no vi ṣya śatāt pāśebhyo vayaṃ tvām ||
english: A hundred are the fetters of Varuṇa, a hundred too of Bṛhaspati; release us, O mortal, from the fetters — from a hundred snares we [release] you.

sanskrit: prācīṃ diśam āsthām agnir māvatv ojase balāya diśāṃ priyo bhūyāsam | anamitrā me diśo bhavantu ghṛtapratīkāḥ ||
english: I have taken my stand toward the eastern quarter; may Agni protect me for strength and power. May I become beloved of the directions. May the quarters be free of enemies for me, their faces shining with ghee.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇāṃ diśam āsthām indro māvatv ojase balāya (…) ||
english: I have taken my stand toward the southern quarter; may Indra protect me for strength and power. [May I become beloved of the directions. May the quarters be free of enemies for me, their faces shining with ghee.]

sanskrit: pratīcīṃ diśam āsthāṃ varuṇo māvatv ojase balāya (…) ||
english: I have taken my stand toward the western quarter; may Varuṇa protect me for strength and power. [May I become beloved of the directions. May the quarters be free of enemies for me, their faces shining with ghee.]

sanskrit: udīcīṃ diśam āsthāṃ somo māvatv ojase balāya (…) ||
english: I have taken my stand toward the northern quarter; may Soma protect me for strength and power. [May I become beloved of the directions. May the quarters be free of enemies for me, their faces shining with ghee.]

sanskrit: dhruvāṃ diśam āsthāṃ viṣṇur māvatv ojase balāya (…) ||
english: I have taken my stand toward the fixed quarter [below/nadir]; may Viṣṇu protect me for strength and power. [May I become beloved of the directions. May the quarters be free of enemies for me, their faces shining with ghee.]

sanskrit: ūrdhvāṃ diśam āsthāṃ bṛhaspatir māvatv ojase balāya diśāṃ priyo bhūyāsam | anamitrā me diśo bhavantu ghṛtapratīkāḥ ||
english: I have taken my stand toward the upward quarter [zenith]; may Bṛhaspati protect me for strength and power. May I become beloved of the directions. May the quarters be free of enemies for me, their faces shining with ghee.
